title: Studio editors and Setup's embedded item drawer still seed their edit copy from the translated served draft, so a non-English save stores the translation as source text
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf

Filing gate: ① product defect, named locations. Out-of-scope findings of #30786 (os-dev-report 6679051267, `out_of_scope_findings` 1 and 2), same family as #29793 and #30786. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: a · reach: named producers (below); the class was measured live for Setup's editor in #30786 (zh-CN app-showcase stack on `origin/main` `9b24f3ca`: the `?state=draft` read is translated, the `/layers` draft layer is not). NOT MEASURED live at these sites.

## Business reason

A tenant who edits an app, a list view, a form or an embedded item in Studio (or in Setup's embedded item drawer) with the console in Chinese, or any non-English locale, can save the translated labels as if the author typed them. English readers then see Chinese, and the author's own view keeps showing the catalog string, so the edit looks reverted. #30786 fixes Setup's metadata editor only; these editors take their edit copy from the same translated read.

## Where (read on the card thread's branch, from `origin/main`)

- Studio, edit body = `extractDraftBody(getDraft(...))` for a translatable type: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (app draft), `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx`, `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `useFormViewDraft.ts`, `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`.
- Setup's embedded item drawer, `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`: an object parent's save is based on `parentDraft = extractDraftBody(client.getDraft(...))`, else `layered.effective ?? layered.code` (translated or governed).

## Wanted

1. Measure first, in a zh-CN console on `main`: one Studio edit per site above on an item with a published zh-CN translation; record the saved body. Say per site whether it carries translations.
2. Each site that reproduces takes its edit copy through the one reading `authoredObjectBuffer.ts` holds after #30786 (`editsAuthoredLayers` / `authoredBuffer` / `authoredPublished`), never a copy of it.
3. Pin each fixed site with a zh-CN test (the saved body carries source labels) plus an ablation.

**Level:** client behaviour only, expected `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**`, `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`).
Dedupe: `studio served draft translated` → #30786 only (the parent); `EmbeddedItemEditor draft` → #30786 only; `extractDraftBody studio translated` → #30786, #25943 (unrelated). **New.**

Related: #29793, #30786, PR #30784, PR #30858.
